preservedResponsibilities: Native name-boundary checkpoint resolves browser paragraph references through actual SwXStyle::getName, scopes its native OUString/wrapper, and uses existing XML name encoding before XMLStyleExport name/display-name emission. Current names, including custom renames and UI/programmatic collisions, replace stale graph IDs at the external XML boundary; internal current-document graph identities remain unchanged. Header, parent, follow and body references share the same actual owner lookup. This is a cohesive naming responsibility split of SwXMLExport, whose main bridge is994 lines, not a new style owner/catalog or a fake UNO query provider. The actual upstream getName/conditional display-name source chain is retained for this slice; full SwXMLExport/UNO/component/filter ABI remains incomplete.
